content.short: Solsea is an open NFT marketplace on Solana.
content.description: Launched in August 2021, Solsea is an open NFT marketplace on the Solana blockchain. Users can buy and sell NFTs with embedded licenses, explore rarity rankings for collections, and connect wallets to trade securely. Developers can access real-time analytics derived from on-chain data to monitor activity and trends. The platform also hosts airdrops for upcoming projects, helping creators and collectors discover new drops and opportunities.
